quiz.question_id: Signature mana yang sesuai dengan definisi middleware pada lesson?
quiz.question_en: Which signature matches the lesson's definition of middleware?
options_en: `func(http.Handler) http.Handler`
`func(http.ResponseWriter, *http.Request)`
`func(func()) http.Handler`
`func(*http.Request) error`

quiz.question_en: Why do the example middlewares return `http.HandlerFunc(...)`?
options_id: Agar handler bisa dijalankan paralel otomatis
Agar request body tersimpan di context
options_en: So handlers automatically run in parallel
Because `http.HandlerFunc` adapts an ordinary function into an `http.Handler`
Because `HandlerFunc` is mandatory for authentication
So the request body is stored in context

quiz.question_id: Apa fungsi `next.ServeHTTP(w, r)` di dalam middleware?
quiz.question_en: What does `next.ServeHTTP(w, r)` do inside middleware?
options_id: Membuat request baru ke server lain
Meneruskan request ke handler atau middleware berikutnya dalam chain
options_en: It creates a new request to another server
It changes the route pattern at runtime
It passes the request to the next handler or middleware in the chain
It closes the connection before the response is sent

quiz.question_id: Jika auth middleware menulis 401 lalu `return` sebelum memanggil `next.ServeHTTP`, apa yang terjadi pada handler berikutnya?
quiz.question_en: If the auth middleware writes a 401 and then `return`s before calling `next.ServeHTTP`, what happens to the next handler?
options_id: Handler berikutnya tetap berjalan tetapi tidak bisa menulis body
options_en: The next handler still runs but cannot write a body
The next handler does not run
All previous middlewares are cancelled
The server automatically retries the request

quiz.question_id: Mengapa fungsi `chain` menerapkan middleware dalam loop terbalik?
quiz.question_en: Why does the `chain` function apply middleware in reverse order?
options_id: Agar middleware pertama yang diberikan menjadi yang pertama menerima request
options_en: So the first middleware provided is the first one to receive the request
So the last middleware is always skipped
Because an `http.Handler` can only be wrapped once
To avoid using context

quiz.question_id: Dengan pemanggilan `chain(apiHandler, loggingMiddleware, authMiddleware)`, urutan eksekusi request yang benar adalah...
quiz.question_en: With the call `chain(apiHandler, loggingMiddleware, authMiddleware)`, what is the correct request execution order?
options_en: auth -> logging -> handler
logging -> auth -> handler
handler -> logging -> auth
logging -> handler -> auth

quiz.question_id: Mengapa sample menggunakan `mux.Handle("/api/", chain(...))` dan bukan `HandleFunc`?
quiz.question_en: Why does the sample use `mux.Handle("/api/", chain(...))` instead of `HandleFunc`?
options_id: Karena hasil `chain(...)` adalah `http.Handler`, bukan function mentah
Karena `HandleFunc` tidak mendukung path dengan slash
Karena middleware hanya bisa dipasang pada `Handle`
options_en: Because the result of `chain(...)` is an `http.Handler`, not a raw function
Because `HandleFunc` does not support paths with slashes
Because middleware can only be attached to `Handle`
Because `HandleFunc` is always global

quiz.question_id: Bagaimana data seperti user dapat diteruskan dari middleware ke handler berikutnya?
quiz.question_en: How can data such as the user be passed from middleware to the next handler?
options_en: By writing it into a response header
By using a package-level global variable
By changing `r.URL.Path`
By using `context.WithValue` and then `r.WithContext(ctx)`

quiz.question_id: Apa manfaat konseptual utama middleware dibanding menaruh logging/auth langsung di setiap handler?
quiz.question_en: What is the main conceptual benefit of middleware compared with putting logging/auth directly in every handler?
options_id: Menambahkan cross-cutting behavior tanpa mengubah handler asli
options_en: It adds cross-cutting behavior without changing the original handler
It makes all routes private
It removes the need for a router
It forces every request to become JSON

quiz.question_id: Route mana pada sample yang sengaja hanya memakai logging dan tidak memakai auth middleware?
quiz.question_en: Which route in the sample intentionally uses only logging and not the auth middleware?
options_en: `/api/`
`/admin/`
`/healthz`
